specific_model_version: Not programmatically exposed; no version-specific model claim
prompt_template: Paraphrase this English event-log extraction request. Preserve its case concept, population, activities, descendant scope, repetition requirement and answerability. For Q1 use natural wording rather than exact activity labels where possible. For Q3 request the entire recorded lifecycle without enumerating activities. Do not add time filters, attributes or activities. Return one paraphrase. Source: {question}

outputs.N01: Build a timeline for each slab showing its receipt, verification and release.
outputs.N02: For every rolling plan, show when it was submitted, approved and released.
outputs.N03: For every rolling instruction, show its issue, the completion of heating and the completion of finish rolling.
outputs.N04: For each mother material, show the completion of charging into the furnace, heating, discharge from the furnace, rough rolling and finish rolling.
outputs.N05: For every mother material, show when heat treatment, surface finishing and dimensional inspection were completed, including work on all plate pieces derived from it.
outputs.N06: For each plate piece, show every completed leveling, heat-treatment and surface-finishing operation, including repeat work.
outputs.N07: For every plate piece, show when its dimensional inspections and quality reviews finished.
outputs.N08: For each plate piece, show when it was identified, released and packed.
outputs.N09: For each individual dimensional inspection record, show when the inspection finished.
outputs.N10: For each individual quality review record, show when the review finished.
outputs.N11: For each equipment unit, show the completion of heating and of heat treatment.
outputs.N12: For every furnace operation record, show the recorded completion of furnace charging, heating or furnace discharge, as applicable.
outputs.N13: For every rolling operation record, show the recorded completion of rough rolling or finish rolling, as applicable.
outputs.N14: For every finishing operation record, show the recorded completion of leveling, heat treatment or surface finishing, as applicable.
outputs.N15: For each slab, show when the steel was cast.
outputs.N16: For each plate piece, show when its truck was dispatched.
outputs.NF01: Show the complete recorded history of each slab.
outputs.NF02: Build the entire recorded timeline for every rolling plan.
outputs.NF03: Trace each rolling instruction through its full recorded history.
outputs.NF04: Show the whole recorded lifecycle of every mother material.
outputs.NF05: Build a complete timeline of the recorded history of each plate piece.
outputs.NF06: Show the entire recorded history of every individual dimensional inspection record.
outputs.NF07: Trace each individual quality review record through its complete recorded history.
outputs.NF08: Show the full recorded history associated with every equipment unit.
outputs.NF09: Build the complete recorded timeline of each individual furnace operation record.
outputs.NF10: Show the whole recorded history of each individual rolling operation record.
outputs.NF11: Trace the entire recorded history of every individual finishing operation record.
